description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the ValidationDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system's API version 2 validator helpers. It verifies the functionality of validation rule application and exception handling in parameter validation logic.

classes.name: ValidationDecoratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the ValidationDecorator logic, extending the base TestCase to include specific validation testing methods.

methods.name: testValidationDecorator
methods.description: Tests proper validation when correct rules and values are provided, asserting a true result.

methods.name: validationDecoratorDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test datasets for successful validation tests, including various parameter sets and rules.

methods.name: testValidationDecoratorWithException
methods.description: Tests validation failures, expecting an InvalidParamException to be thrown with invalid inputs.

methods.name: validationDecoratorWithExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides datasets that are expected to trigger validation exceptions.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of ValidationDecorator used in the tests.
